metadata.title: Vocom International | Wholesale Fiber Optic Cable & Carrier Services
metadata.description: Vocom International is a fiber optic cable supplier and telecommunications carrier, providing wholesale build-to-order cable, private circuits, IP transit and voice termination across cross-Pacific and Asia-Pacific routes.

attributes.text: One Global Carrier, Three Business Lines, Since 1998

Vocom International Telecommunications is a facilities-based, FCC 214 licensed carrier headquartered in Los Angeles. Vocom routes voice, data, fiber, mobile and AI infrastructure for partner carriers across six continents, from wholesale IDD termination in 1998 to Supermicro AI compute today.
Direct carrier and NNI partners across Asia, the Americas and Europe
Every account is handled by a real engineer, not a support queue:
Step 1: Tell Us What You Are Building
Send your route, workload or deployment requirements, voice, data, fiber, mobile or AI compute.
Our engineers size the connection or deployment and put it live on Vocom’s own network.
Twenty-seven years of network engineering, not resold capacity:
Hundreds of direct carrier and NNI relationships
24/7 NOC monitoring across every business line
20+ global PoPs and IDCs across Asia-Pacific, EMEA and the Americas
Owned MPLS/VPLS backbone with direct cloud connectivity
Carrier-neutral IDC footprint hosting AI-ready compute
Wholesale IDD termination and carrier-grade SMS routing, built on direct NNI relationships with hundreds of carriers worldwide.
Global IP transit and Layer 2 Ethernet, IEPL/IPLC private lines, MPLS-VPN and Anti-DDoS, blended per carrier across the global and China routes.
Tier-1 sourced outside-plant and indoor fiber optic cable, delivered build-to-order in 6 to 8 weeks standard, up to 10 weeks for high-count or custom builds.
A global eSIM storefront at ezsim.com, plus Vocom’s T-Mobile MVNO service in the US and MNO status in Canada.
Authorized Supermicro reseller, deploying AI-ready compute inside Vocom’s own carrier-neutral data centers.
Consulting, procurement, logistics, installation and troubleshooting for overseas network deployments, end to end.
The same network operations center watches every business line, from voice routes to AI compute.
Regional scrubbing centers across Asia and the US/EU keep volumetric and application-layer attacks off the route.
One carrier-grade backbone, three business lines:
Built One PoP at a Time Since 1998
A condensed look at how the network grew, the full story lives on Vocom’s own site.

attributes.$control__testimonial1: 1998: VOCOM established, HQ in Los Angeles. Voice wholesale and the first data center online.
attributes.$control__testimonial2: 2012: Mobile Data, eSIM and SMS business launched. Singapore and Tokyo PoPs online.
attributes.$control__testimonial3: 2026: AI server business launched. Seoul, London, Sao Paulo, Toronto and Sihanoukville PoPs online.

attributes.text: We are here to clear your doubts:

attributes.$control__question: Is VOCOM a reseller or a facilities-based carrier?
attributes.$control__answer: VOCOM is a facilities-based carrier operating under an FCC International Bureau license, not a reseller. It has run its own equipment and interconnects since 1998.
Send your route, workload or deployment requirements to sales@vocom.com. A real engineer or account manager replies directly, not a ticket queue.

attributes.$control__question: Which regions does VOCOM's network reach?
attributes.$control__answer: VOCOM operates 20+ PoPs and IDCs across Asia-Pacific, Europe and EMEA, and North and South America, with particular strength across the Pacific.

attributes.$control__question: Do you supply wholesale fiber optic cable internationally?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. Vocom International supplies wholesale, build-to-order fiber optic cable for telecommunications, infrastructure and data center projects worldwide, alongside its carrier services.

attributes.text: © 2026 Vocom International Telecommunications, Inc. All rights reserved.
